title: Sum of Two Integers (Method Only)
description: Write a **public** Java class named `Solution` with a public static method `sum` that takes two integers, `a` and `b`, and returns their sum. *Do not write a main method.*

title: Factorial Calculation (Full Program)
description: Write a **public** class named `Solution` containing a **`main` method**. In `main`, use `java.util.Scanner` to read a single non-negative integer `n` (up to 12) from standard input, calculate its factorial, and print the result followed by a newline.

title: Reverse a String (Method Only)
description: Implement a **public static method** `reverse` within the `Solution` class that takes a String and returns a new String with the characters in reverse order. *Do not write a main method.*

title: Snail Class Simulation (Method Only)
description: Create two classes: a **`Snail`** class with private fields for its name and speed, a constructor, and a public `move` method. Then, create a **`Solution`** class containing a public static `simulateRace` method that instantiates and uses the `Snail` class. The compiler will call `simulateRace`. Ensure both classes are defined in the editor. *Do not write a main method.*
